viewerQuestion: These two builds cost the same. What do the numbers on this page actually settle?
viewerTakeaway: I can apply a three-step check to any comparison page and know when its numbers are too close to act on.

beats.narration: Here is a three-step check you can run on any comparison page, starting with this one.
Step one: write down what would actually answer your question, before you look for the bigger number.
On this comparison every per-game difference is smaller than the range SpecSmith's model declares for its own estimates, so the model does not separate them on frame rate. These are model estimates.
beats.onScreenText: Step 2: read the range, not just the value

beats.narration: Step three: name what is still unsettled. Here that is everything outside frame rate, and this page does not cover it.
Run those three steps on the comparison you actually care about.
